content: अलक्षण {%a.%} .²1 Having no signs or marks. .²2 Having no characteristic or distinguishing marks, undefined, undistinguished; आसीदिदं तमोभूतमप्रज्ञातमलक्षणम् <ls>Ms. 1. 5</ls>. .²3 Having no good marks, inauspicious, unfortunate, ill-omened; क्लेशावहा भर्तुरलक्षणाहम् <ls>R. 14. 5</ls>. .²4 Incomprehensible; सैषा विष्णोर्महामायाऽबाधयाऽलक्षणा यया <ls>Bhāg. 12. 6. 29</ls>. .{@-णम्@} .²1 A bad or inauspicious sign; आचारो हन्त्यलक्षणम् <ls>Ms. 4. 156</ls>. .²2 That which is no definition, a bad definition.
